user_input: I'm a confirmed employee and I'm resigning. How long is my notice period, and what happens to my unused annual leave when I leave?
response: As a confirmed employee, your notice period is 60 days [3]. Regarding your unused annual leave, it will be encashed at exit up to a maximum of 30 days at basic salary [4]. Please note that annual leave cannot be taken during the notice period unless approved by your manager, and any balance exceeding 30 days does not carry over or get paid out beyond that limit [1][2].
retrieved_contexts:

Annual leave may not be taken during the notice period except with manager approval; unused annual leave is encashed at exit up to 30 days, as described in the Leave Policy.

18. Frequently Asked Questions
Can I encash unused annual leave while I am still employed?
No. Annual leave is encashed only on exit, up to 30 days. Balances above 10 days lapse on 31 December each year.

4. Notice Period
The notice period is 60 days for confirmed employees and 30 days for employees still on probation. Notice period buy-out is at the company's discretion.

4. Annual Leave
4.2 Joiners and leavers
Employees who join part-way through a month accrue leave for that month only if they join on or before the 15th. Employees who leave Acme Corp accrue leave up to their last working day on the same basis. On exit, any accrued but unused annual leave is encashed at basic salary, up to a maximum of 30 days. Leave taken in excess of the accrued balance at exit is recovered from the final settlement.
reference: The notice period is 60 days for confirmed employees. Any accrued but unused annual leave is encashed at exit at basic salary, up to a maximum of 30 days.

user_input: How much per diem do I get on the day I fly back from a domestic business trip?
response: On the day you fly back from a domestic business trip, you receive 75% of the daily rate, which is INR 2,250 (calculated as 75% of INR 3,000) [2], [4].
retrieved_contexts:
14. Frequently Asked Questions
Do I get per diem for a day trip from Bengaluru to Chennai?
Yes, 50% of the domestic rate (INR 1,500) if the trip lasts more than 8 hours.

9. Per Diem
Meals and incidentals are covered by a daily allowance of INR 3,000 for domestic travel and USD 75 for international travel. No receipts are needed for per diem.

9. Per Diem
9.2 Worked example
An employee travels from Hyderabad to Mumbai on Monday morning and returns on Wednesday evening. They receive 75% of INR 3,000 for Monday (INR 2,250), 100% for Tuesday (INR 3,000) and 75% for Wednesday (INR 2,250), a total of INR 7,500.

9. Per Diem
9.1 How per diem is calculated
- Per diem is paid for each calendar day on which the employee is travelling and away from their home city overnight.
- On the departure day and the return day, 75% of the daily rate is paid.
- Day trips with no overnight stay receive 50% of the daily rate if the trip lasts more than 8 hours.
- Where meals are provided by a client, conference or hotel package, per diem is not reduced.
reference: On the departure day and the return day, 75% of the daily rate is paid. The domestic per diem is INR 3,000, so the return day pays INR 2,250.

user_input: I'm an L4 employee. Can I get a premium economy upgrade on an international flight?
response: No, you cannot get a premium economy upgrade on an international flight. According to the policy, premium economy upgrades are "Not reimbursed" for employees at levels L1 through L4 [1]. Additionally, the flight entitlement table specifies that employees at L1-L4 must fly in Economy class regardless of the trip type or duration [3].
retrieved_contexts:

| Premium economy upgrade | Not reimbursed | Allowed on international flights of 5 to 8 hours |
The 8-hour threshold refers to the scheduled duration of a single flight segment, not the total journey including layovers. A Bengaluru to London journey with a layover in Dubai is two segments of under 8 hours each and is therefore economy class.

6. Air Travel
Domestic flights must be booked in economy class. International flights longer than 8 hours may be booked in business class for employees at level L5 or above; all other international travel is economy class. All flights must be booked through the AcmeTravel portal at least 14 days in advance where possible.

Yes. International flight segments longer than 8 hours may be booked in business class for L5 and above.
